name: advance-codex
description: Capability plugin for strengthening Codex surfaces across skills, scenario testing, token optimization, commits, and plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Strengthen skills, token optimization, scenario testing, commits, and plugins.
interface.longDescription: Provides skills for strengthening Codex surfaces: shaping reusable skills, packaging coherent plugins, testing reusable instructions with fixed scenarios and fresh executors, finalizing Codex-made changes into stable commits, and reducing agent wording tokens without losing correctness, meaning-bearing context, or verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: When a skill is needed, forget previously loaded skill context and reread the current skill body before applying it.
Use $advance-codex:plugin-creator to package a plugin and define the right bundled surfaces.
Use $advance-codex:skill-creator to design a reusable Codex skill with the right references, guardrails, and description trigger metadata.
Use $advance-codex:skill-scenario-testing to test reusable instructions with fresh subagents, fixed scenarios, and caller-side metrics before reporting evidence-backed findings.

Use $advance-codex:git-committer to prepare and execute a task-scoped commit when commit is part of the requested work, including a broader PR workflow, with staged verification, commit-message hygiene, and post-commit confirmation.

Use $advance-codex:optimize-token to reduce agent wording tokens in responses, progress updates, status notes, verification notes, and approval boundaries while preserving correctness, meaning-bearing context, verification evidence, approval boundaries, required output format, and current-state accuracy.
